out_items.name: Proper disposition of returned, previously served, reconditioned and unsafe food

violations.title: Returned Food & Re-service of Food
violations.observation: Observed food service employee take back taco that was missing ingredient from customer.
violations.corrective_action: EHS educated employee that once food is served to customer, it cannot come back into kitchen for any reason other than to be discarded. Any missing ingredient must be provided to the customer separately and for the customer to add OR entire dish must be remade.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed 2024 food establishment permit posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please contact 703-246-2201 or email [county email] for a copy of your 2025 food establishment permit and post in a conspicuous location.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that caulking behind the 3 compartment sink and wall is in need of replacing
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will request to replace caulking behind 3 compartment sink.
